title: Integrated Transcriptomic and Functional Analyses Identify SERPINE1 as a Ferroptosis-Associated Mediator of Glioblastoma Radioresistance.
snippet: Radiotherapy failure remains a major challenge in glioblastoma (GBM), yet the stress-adaptive programs that enable tumor cells to survive irradiation-induced lethal injury remain incompletely defined.
